items.q: What should you remember about **Mindset before tactics**?
items.a: **frameworks without mental shifts** = recipe hoarding without cooking.

items.q: What should you remember about **Nerves = self-consciousness**?
items.a: **cognitive capacity spent on "me me** me" leaves no room but more anxiety; redirect to serving the audience.

items.q: What should you remember about **Audience-conscious, not self-conscious**?
items.a: **focus on one person you** might help; American "how can I serve you?" service framing.

items.q: What should you remember about **"The one thing" sentence starter**?
items.a: **forces end-in-mind focus; escalate** to "the two things" or "top three things" when ready.

items.q: What should you remember about **Topic ≠ communicator**?
items.a: **Neil deGrasse Tyson makes physics** lovable; boring finance professors make finance hated; use metaphors, demos, funny visuals.

items.q: What should you remember about **Interviews = storytelling permission**?
items.a: **"tell me about yourself" is** a free story slot; behavioral questions are hidden story prompts too.

items.q: What should you remember about **Head of Innovation demo**?
items.a: **accounting dropout → magic** → problem-solving obsession → role bridge (extends origin story interview).

items.q: What should you remember about **Brad gets the job**?
items.a: **rapport and storytelling beat** raw intelligence when smarter candidates list traits instead.

items.q: What should you remember about **Man in the Arena**?
items.a: **only weight feedback from people** actually in the arena with you (Theodore Roosevelt via Brené Brown).

items.q: What should you remember about **Please everyone → please no one**?
items.a: **water-theater rule; fear of** disruption leads to doing nothing different.

items.q: What should you remember about **Spotlight effect**?
items.a: **people think about their own butter choices, not your vocal slip; Mark Twain**: "how seldom they do.".

items.q: What should you remember about **Open mouth = practice**?
items.a: **vocal teacher**: "every time you open your mouth, that is you composing"; solo self-talk counts.
